info.cls_ename: Continuing Education Bachelor's Program of Interior Design

description.describe_ch: 本課程為繪畫實習課程。課程中，主要以單色鉛筆或炭筆為主要表現素材，初期以基本造形、構圖能力之訓練為主，強調造形比例的精準與否並輔以明暗對比之表現為主要考量。期中期末亦安排其他藝術相關課程，以增進學習之深度及廣度。期末則配合幻燈片等，以記憶速寫來訓練造形速度之能力。本課程特別注重個人自我要求及實踐方法表達，無期中、期末考試。
description.describe_eh: This curriculum for drawing practice curriculum. In the curriculum, mainly take the monochromatic pencil or the charcoal pencil as the main performance source material, the initial period take the basic shape, training the composition ability primarily, the emphasis shape proportion essence or not and auxiliary performance of by the light and shade contrast as the main consideration. The time at the end of intermediate stage also arranges other artistic correlation curricula, promotes depth of and the breadth the study. Later period coordinates the slide and so on, to the memory sketches trains ability of the shape speed. This curriculum specially pays great attention to personal self- requirement and the practice method expression, does not have the midterm examination.
